summary: std/x509: IP name constraints whose address carries host bits are masked before matching, as Go 1.27.4
details: IP name constraints whose address carries host bits are masked before matching, as Go 1.27.4; an excluded range written with host bits could fail to exclude an address in it. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, native backends): IP name constraints whose address carries host bits are masked before matching, as Go 1.27.4; an excluded range written with host bits could fail to exclude an address in it. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
